title: University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNCC)
summary: University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNCC) is a university in Charlotte. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with UNCC.

sections.heading: What UNCC is known for
paragraphs: The University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNCC) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant undergraduate enrollment of 24,453 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 79.6%, reflecting a moderately selective admissions process. UNCC is particularly recognized for its strong programs in business and health fields, with business programs comprising about 19.36% of the academic offerings and health-related programs making up roughly 7.93%. These areas highlight the university's commitment to preparing students for careers in dynamic and essential sectors.

sections.heading: How to read UNCC tuition
paragraphs: The University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNCC) provides distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. In-state tuition is set at $7,239, reflecting the reduced cost for residents of North Carolina. Out-of-state students are charged a higher tuition rate of $22,492. The overall cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, housing, and supplies, totals $23,010. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending UNCC.
